world.h: Iran says it shot down two US drones over Hormuz
world.b: Iranian forces say they downed two US drones over the Strait of Hormuz as the United States steps up its economic pressure campaign and efforts to end the war remain stalled.

world.h: Honduras court convicts four, including three Americans
world.b: A court in Honduras convicted four people, three of them US citizens, of criminal association in connection with the 2022 disappearance of a woman whose whereabouts are still unknown.

world.h: Houthis fire three missiles at Riyadh
world.b: The coalition said it intercepted the ballistic missiles Saturday, two days after a Houthi strike damaged the Public Investment Fund tower, Riyadh's tallest skyscraper.

national.h: Jury convicts man of starting the Palisades Fire
national.b: After an earlier mistrial, jurors convicted Jonathan Rinderknecht, 30, of arson for lighting the Jan. 1, 2025, fire that flared up days later into the Palisades Fire, which killed 12 people in Los Angeles and Malibu.
national.title: Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles

national.h: Trump's proposed arch could shadow Arlington cemetery
national.b: President Trump's proposed 250-foot arch near Arlington National Cemetery could shade gravesites, disrupt visits with construction noise and alter the capital's historic landscape, families of the fallen worry.
national.title: For families of the fallen, Trump’s proposed arch casts a shadow over Arlington National Cemetery

national.h: Army plans detonations of degraded explosive in Iowa
national.b: The US Army plans two controlled detonations at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant to destroy 68 drums of degraded lead azide, a volatile lead-based explosive, under an emergency EPA permit.
national.title: Why is the US Army detonating lead-rich explosives in Iowa?

national.h: Storms on both coasts threaten Thanksgiving travel
national.b: Severe weather is expected on both US coasts next week. San Francisco's mayor urged residents to avoid nonessential travel as the city prepares for extreme high tides and rain.
national.title: Storms expected on both coasts threatens Thanksgiving travel

national.h: FBI investigating apparent hack of national crime database
national.b: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center, the database police use for records on fugitives, missing persons and criminal history, a person familiar with the matter told the AP.
national.title: AP source: FBI investigating apparent hack of its key national criminal justice database

national.h: Witness disputes Texas account of a troubled execution
national.b: Texas defended its execution of 70-year-old Reinaldo Dennes, who pleaded "Don't let me suffer like this" during a lethal injection that followed a struggle to find a vein. His spiritual adviser described severe distress in the Huntsville death chamber.

politics.h: Trump orders contractors to consult White House on Congress requests
politics.b: A new executive order directs federal contractors to consult the administration about inquiries from Congress and withhold communications the White House deems privileged, or risk losing their contracts.
politics.title: Trump orders federal contractors to check with White House before responding to Congress

politics.h: Trump says he would work with Democrats to cap card rates
politics.b: President Trump said he would work with the incoming Democratic Congress to cap credit card interest rates, a 2024 campaign promise. The standard proposal caps rates at 10%, against a median of about 22.2%.
politics.title: Trump vows to work with Democrats to cap credit card interest rates at 10%

international.h: Bahrain says Iranian attack set industrial site on fire
international.b: Bahrain's Defence Force said its air defences intercepted a number of Iranian aerial attacks late Saturday, and one struck a civilian industrial facility, starting a fire. Preliminary reports pointed to no injuries.
international.title: Bahrain says Iranian attack causes fire at industrial facility

international.h: COP31 climate talks in Antalya go into overtime
international.b: Negotiators at the UN climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, went into an extra day on Saturday after a draft final agreement drew strong condemnation for failing to mention fossil fuels. Hopes for concrete plans to cut fossil fuel use are slim.

international.h: Mexico arrests alleged cartel boss 'Chapo Isidro'
international.b: Mexican special forces arrested Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores, on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, along with two other men in Guasave, Sinaloa, on Friday night, Mexico's defence ministry said.
international.title: Who is El Chapo Isidro, the alleged cartel boss arrested in Mexico?

international.h: India's opposition youth wing protests at Meta offices
international.b: The Indian Youth Congress protested outside Meta offices in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram, demanding the company restore its leaders' Instagram accounts. The protests led to clashes with police and security guards.
international.title: India’s opposition stages protests against Meta over account removals

international.h: Crew evacuates Russian ship hit by drones off Finland
international.b: The crew of the Russian cargo ship Sparta II, struck by drones likely launched by Ukraine in the Gulf of Finland, was being evacuated into life rafts. Finnish authorities say the ship has links to Russia's armed forces.
international.title: Crew evacuated amid battle to put out fire on Russian ship hit by drones

international.h: Israeli strike on food aid van kills three in Gaza City
international.b: An Israeli strike on a van carrying food aid west of Gaza City killed three people, part of attacks that killed at least four Palestinians in Gaza despite last year's ceasefire, as winter flooding deepens the crisis.
international.title: Israeli strike on vehicle distributing food aid in Gaza kills three

international.h: Toxic liquor kills at least 11 in India's Manipur
international.b: At least 11 people died after drinking suspected spurious alcohol in northeast India's Manipur state, and more than 180 had been admitted to hospitals as of Friday. Authorities have opened an investigation.

international.h: Geneva talks agree to keep working on 'killer robot' rules
international.b: At a UN conference in Geneva, 128 countries agreed to "elaborate" on a possible accord regulating lethal autonomous weapons over the next two years, after nearly 100 nations pushed for swift, legally binding rules.

international.h: Fire at power station near Basra kills at least four
international.b: A fire broke out at the Hartha power station north of Basra in southern Iraq, killing at least four people and injuring 35, according to Iraqi state media.

business.h: Judge approves Bayer's Roundup settlement worth up to $7.25 billion
business.b: A Missouri judge gave final approval to Bayer's nationwide settlement with people who say the weed-killer Roundup caused their cancer, a deal that could cost the company up to $7.25 billion.
business.title: Bayer reaches Roundup settlement that could cost the company billions

business.h: Bessent says no new limits needed on Nvidia chip sales to China
business.b: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said no further restrictions on sales of older Nvidia chips to China are needed, after the administration moved this week to block China's remote access to the latest semiconductors.

business.h: Critics say Anthropic's IPO will test its safety pledge
business.b: Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq this week, and critics say its commitment to put safety ahead of commercial success will now be tested as a public company.
business.title: Anthropic says it will put humanity first. Will its IPO change that?

business.h: AI stocks slump in one of Wall Street's worst weeks in a while
business.b: AI-related stocks and the broader market were pummeled this week, with investors fearing a sector bubble could be bursting. Anthropic's market debut failed to provide the hoped-for lift.
business.title: The AI boom had a really bad week — and it's raising loud alarms

science.h: Anthropic mathematician claims AI-assisted Riemann proof
science.b: Levent Alpoge, a mathematician at Anthropic, wrote that he believes he has discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis working with Claude.

science.h: How much should climate plans lean on carbon capture?
science.b: ProPublica spoke with three leading climate modelers about the assumptions behind models that count on capturing and storing carbon, a technology ProPublica calls unproven.
science.title: Why Is the World Still Counting on Unproven Carbon Capture Technology?

sports.h: Prochazka meets Stirling in UFC main event in Qatar
sports.b: Former light heavyweight champion Jiri Prochazka faces rising star Navajo Stirling in Saturday's UFC Fight Night main event in Qatar. Stirling is seeking his fourth win of 2026.

local.h: Homeless man charged with murder in Chinatown killing
local.b: Police charged a homeless man with murder after a 62-year-old woman was found dead with signs of trauma to her neck at her Catherine Street apartment on Friday.
local.title: NYPD charges homeless man with murder after woman, 62, was killed at her Chinatown home

local.h: FDNY leaders on lithium-ion fires and EMS shortages
local.b: Fire deaths have nearly doubled since last year, many driven by lithium-ion batteries, and EMS response times remain at a record high. FDNY Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore discussed the department's response on WNYC.
local.title: FDNY grapples with lithium-ion danger, EMS shortages and a building collapse

local.h: National Grid gas rate freeze approved, but costs may follow
local.b: State regulators approved a yearlong rate freeze for nearly 2 million National Grid gas customers in the city and on Long Island, but customers will still be on the hook for capital spending during the freeze.
local.title: New York approves National Grid rate freeze, but customers could see higher bills soon

local.h: Judge keeps man shot by ICE in the Bronx in custody
local.b: A federal judge ruled Oscar Belgal, wounded when federal agents fired on his SUV in the Bronx in October, will stay in custody while the administration pursues his deportation.
local.title: Federal judge in NY denies release of man shot by ICE in the Bronx

local.h: Rain returns Sunday, and another storm may hit Thanksgiving
local.b: Showers arrive Sunday afternoon and may linger into the Monday commute, with an inch or two of rain expected across the city. Forecasters are already watching a second storm near Thanksgiving.
local.title: Rain once again coming for NYC's idyllic fall — and maybe Thanksgiving, too

Chance of precipitation is 100%. New precipitation amounts between a half and three quarters of an inch possible.

periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 66. West wind 11 to 13 mph.

periods.name: Monday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 43. Northwest wind 11 to 15 mph.
